text: This was excellent. Choosing where to go for the first time is a bit of a shot in the dark, and this worked out really well. I figured a temple was a good bet! Lovely head, shoulders and back massage. I advised of some disc issues I have in my neck via Google translate, which was noted and respected. Simple and clean surroundings in the grounds of the temple. Very good value for money.

Found this place next to my hotel,located in a quiet and pleasant temple,we were here around 12pm, not hot at all even thought they don’t have AC.
Very cheap price compare to the average in Thailand.
As a friend told me,temple massage is the best, it’s one of the original places to learn about thai massage, there are some certifications like papers hanged at the entrance, if you don’t know whether a massage place is good or not,those certifications can be an endorsement。

overall， its a very great experience in Chiangmai old town.

Highly recommended!

What they do to you is unbelievable. I never felt that relief. Can’t wait to come again and get my back good again. They really know what they do so don’t expect a lovely nice and soft massage. This is medical and they will walk on your legs ;) it’s painful but good 👍 …
I've been coming to this temple since the first time I set foot in Chiang Mai 20 years ago, and still choosing it, I love the atmosphere and the therapists are skilled.
Best place to have traditional massage, super professional and know all your needs!

Simple setting, lovely staff (with great hands) and a very cheap massage for such good quality.
I felt really comfortable there and walked out feeling reborn!
Wow - just came across this place whilst wandering , the price was better than all the rest and I had a foot massage - it was superb !
Best place in Chiang Mai for actual Thai massage. Very reasonable prices and good professionals. My favourite masseuse is called May, she has magic hands for massage

I had massage with many of the therapist there and had a great experience every time. They are very good in fixing your body, my place to go when I need some adjustments.

The prices are very affordable and I encourage you to give tips if you enjoyed your massage.

the man who was doing the massage was talking and laughing with his partner all the time.  Later I realized that they were laughing at me.  The partner touched me on the arm while he was laughing.  I asked them several times "what's wrong?" but they didn't answer me. They were very unrespectful. I have never felt so uncomfortable in a massage.  You are supposed to enjoy and relax in a massage... not here.  In the middle of the massage I couldn't take it anymore and I left.  All the girls that worked asked me what had happened and they told me "sorry, sorry". The owner was not there, it's a pity. The worst half-massage in my life.
Best price and good quality massage I've ever had in thailand.
A great place to relax and enjoy a fantastic massage in the comfort of the grounds of the Temple
The woman who did my massage did it in such a rush. Quite hard and painful too. Not as good as people say.

The guy tells me to come back in 30 minutes. I waited around , came back, and they say they are close.
So professional

Just had an amazing massage by Mr. Sin. I chose a combination of 20 minutes of Tok Sen (for my back) and 40 minutes of regular Thai Massage. Next time my back screams for attention, I will go here again!

It was a wonderful experience here. I stayed for two days, once for a foot massage and once for a full body massage. The foot massage was painful, but excellent. The lady knew exactly what she was doing; she knew exactly how far she could go. The second day, a full body massage—well, we Westerners could learn a thing or two from that. Both times, even with short breaks, they massage with all their heart and soul, and it shows. Kind regards, because it was fantastic, Harry.

I had a foot massage for 190 THB for an hour, and it was incredibly good. There was no air conditioning, only a fan, and instead of healing music, they were playing pop songs on the radio, so it was a different atmosphere from a typical massage parlor, but there was a strange sense of openness and I was able to relax from the bottom of my heart. According to the sign on the wall, a room with air conditioning costs an extra 10 THB, they are open until 11 PM on Sundays (maybe because of the Sunday market), and although the temple closes after 6 PM, they are open on the adjacent property (I'm not sure where...).

text:
There's absolutely no need to feel intimidated just because she's a tiny lady. 
She doesn't use force, but rather pinpoints the pressure, so it's incredibly effective!! 

The price is 190B for one hour.

There are three courses: full body, legs, and shoulders and neck.

This is probably the cheapest option.

For such a low price, it's truly excellent value for money!

There's no air conditioning or relaxing music; but the auntie with incredibly strong massage skills, the naturally ventilated environment, and the sounds of insects and birds make it all worthwhile. It actually helps you feel more integrated into Chiang Mai life.

Unlike other massage parlors where tourists dominate, this place seemed to have a significant local population. Overall, at such a low price, it's fantastic and well worth it.

The best value massage in Chiang Mai.
They offer over 60 minutes of massage alone, rather than pre- and post-service services.
Don't expect fancy interiors or couples rooms.
Don't be surprised if they wipe your feet with wet wipes beforehand.
(I wasn't surprised, since I read reviews on Google beforehand.)
It seems like a popular spot for locals.
The masseuses appear to be professionals with decades of experience.
The entrance feels like a temple, so it's easy to miss.

It was really refreshing because they rubbed all the way to the bones.. haha ​​The next day my whole body ached and I thought I was going to die^^
But considering the price, there is no place better than this. I paid 190 baht for an hour and then the lady said she needed to work on my shoulders more.. I came back for 290. At first, she chatted with the people next to her and took it easy, but after a while, she showed off her power that could even break a cow's bones. haha ​​I still recommend it. Adjust the intensity and get it. I got it from the lady ^^

It seems like they have skills, but they don't do their best^^... The hygiene is also below the level.. The masseuse sends a phone call while giving a massage, and in between, she eats a snack and gives a massage with her hands😄 …

I went after seeing the reviews below. 140 baht for an hour lol. How about being a little perfunctory? For 140 baht... It seems like they're doing it roughly? If you ask them to do it harder, that's when they start getting serious. No matter what I do, I'm satisfied with 140 baht.

We stumbled upon this place and were surprised by the price difference compared to other Thai massage parlors. Entering through a narrow alley, we saw satisfied customers leaving, all agreeing that the massages offered in the temples were well worth trying. And they were right. They gave us clean clothes to change into and treated us to an authentic Thai massage from head to toe. The place was air-conditioned with relaxing background music, although some of the masseuses were talking amongst themselves and on their phones during the massage, which was a bit distracting. You leave exhausted but refreshed.
There was only a fan, but the environment was nice and cool, and the massage was very comfortable. It cost 180 baht for an hour of Thai massage.
Excellent! I'm a Thai person who can vouch for this being the best Thai massage place in Chiang Mai 👍👍👍 …
We've enjoyed several excellent Thai and foot massages. For us, this is the top place in Chiang Mai.
This is the place to go if you want an authentic massage. It's inside a temple where you'll also find food stalls, shade, and more. Authentic Thai massage.

I got a foot massage. The environment was clean, but a little shabby, so I was a little worried when they wiped my feet with wet tissues, but the massage was so so so cool that I fainted ㅜㅜ They even applied tiger balm to the bruises on my legs. The massage was really the best, much better than the expensive shop I went to yesterday. I got a massage while feeling the breeze from the fan, so it was cool for me, who easily gets hot. I highly recommend it for a short break while traveling. The person I got the massage from was ubon!

I've taken lessons in many countries, but this is the first time I've encountered someone so skilled. 
Amazing! And the price is reasonable!

The massage therapists are skilled and hit the spot. Although there's no air conditioning, the natural breeze and electric fan provide plenty of ventilation, and the sound of soft music, birdsong, and the wind makes it feel very natural and comfortable. I've had massages two days in a row and would love to come again if I have the chance.
This is probably the cheapest massage place in Chiang Mai! I'm curious how they can come up with such a low price. I've been here twice, and the staff are all so nice!

If you don't want to massage a Thai person, just say so. They gossip about customers in their local dialect. Do you think they can't understand? If you don't have service mind, why do you expect a tip?

I had two body massages (220 THB per hour) at a massage parlor inside Wat Sam Pao. The therapists were all veterans, so I had no complaints. I think it was probably one of the cheapest in the old town, but I think it closes at 5 PM, so be careful about the time.

text: This is unlike any Thai massage I've ever had!! It feels like my pelvis is being rebuilt.

He has two locations. One is in an alley behind a temple, and it has air conditioning. The masseuse who massaged me seemed to have poor technique, or maybe she was slacking off, as she kept massaging the same spot. The massage staff were also chatting loudly and unabashedly, which is really rare in Thai massage parlors. I reminded them, but they continued chatting and discussing customers. Because they are locals, I could understand some of what they said. 190 baht an hour is cheap, but I won't come back. It was a very bad experience.

Very cheap, and the massage was quite good. 360 baht for a two-hour Thai massage is perfect for a visit after checking out of the hotel when you have some free time. The masseuse was very friendly, and although there was no air conditioning, the fan kept you cool, so you didn't feel hot.

Foot massage: 190 baht per hour, cash only.
I visited this place to experience quality and culture, not just value.

It's located in a temple, but the massage is similar to other massages. There's no AC.

It's cheaper than nearby massage parlors. I changed into a uniform for a Thai massage. I can speak basic English. I started with a Thai massage, and upon noticing my stiff shoulders, the masseuse emphasized them more. …
The massage was amazing! The price was totally worth it.

The service and massage skills were abysmal. During service, the employee repeatedly left the room, drank, and dazed. The massage was also performed with a foot press rather than kneading, leaving me feeling unresponsive and painful. The massage was also 10 minutes too short. Be careful not to be tempted by the price.
It's amazing. I went every day for ten days and got a two-hour oil massage.

Very cheap. Starting at 190 per hour. I had two massages; the masseuses were both very strong, and it didn't hurt at all, just right. However, it's a large communal room with no private spaces, so the environment is a bit lacking.

Excellent basic Thai massage, only 150 baht per hour—we haven't seen that price anywhere else in Chiang Mai. The foot massage is so-so; it's better to get a full-body Thai massage. There aren't always openings on weekends; you have to show up, sign up for a waiting list, and they'll tell you what time a therapist will be available.

It is the best massage. Highly recommended for both Thai and neck/shoulder treatments.

Thai massages are 150 baht for an hour or 230 baht for an hour and a half. Other places charge 200 or 300 baht, so it's really affordable. It varies depending on the masseuse, but I've been going every day since I discovered it during my trip. It's refreshing.
Thai massage 1 hour 190
The price was good, but the air-conditioned place was a bit of a walk away. If you go according to the map, it's hot, but I saw people getting massages with the windows open.

I found out this massage shop was nearby after booking my accommodation, and it was totally awesome. The location of the place is great too. If it isn't enough, just say "Nak-nak" (straighten up). Then they'll rub harder. I think it's excellent for this price.
The massage for my body and feet was very comfortable and cool, and the music was great too!
A very good massage shop in Chiang Mai's Old Town. The quality of the massages is excellent and the prices are reasonable.
Very good massage
This massage parlor offers great value for money. It also opens earlier than other places, making it a great place to visit if you want a massage in the morning.
It just hurts
I had 7 massages in 8 days in Chiang Mai, and the masseuses here are the best.
I received it with a handkerchief on the pillow. It was good value for money. I received it twice.
Just woooow
Cost-effective. However, each masseuse's skills may vary.
The plump auntie was very strong; she massaged all the sore spots and it felt very comfortable afterwards.
